question: In the passage, the word "**ephemeral"** most nearly means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2)** i.e. Transient.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ephemeral"** means lasting for a very short time. (क्षणिक)

 
 
• **Example: **The beauty of the cherry blossoms is ephemeral, lasting only a few weeks each year.
 
 
 
• **"Transient" **means lasting only for a short time; impermanent. (क्षणिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The transient nature of youth is something we all become aware of as we grow older.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'ephemeral' **is most closely related to **'transient'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Transient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Everlasting **(अनंत): Lasting forever or a very long time.

 
 
• **Example: **The love between the couple was described as everlasting.
 
 
 
• **Powerful **(शक्तिशाली): Having great power or strength.
 
 
• **Example: **The powerful speech moved everyone in the audience.
 
 
 
• **Fragile** (कमजोर): Easily broken or damaged.
 
 
• **Example: **Be careful with that vase; it's very fragile.
